verdict.rationale: Built-in AI insights are a fair question for a managed database console, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no in-product AI that generates insights or suggestions from user data. What it does show is adjacent: an MCP server that lets external coding agents run SQL, plus SQL-threshold alerting and observability views. Neither produces AI insights inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
